scene.1.body.en: Three months old, alone, abandoned, and nobody to care for him.
scene.1.body.es: Con apenas tres meses de edad, solo, sin que nadie lo cuidara.

scene.2.label.es: Un ruido llamativo en la calle.

scene.2.body.en: Children — playing at the park at the end of the road.
scene.2.body.es: Unos niños — jugando en el parque.

scene.3.body.en: Something about it was worth a closer look.
scene.3.body.es: Algo le dijo que valía la pena acercarse.

scene.4.body.en: The children couldn't resist playing with such a cute dog, and at bedtime Oliver followed them home.
scene.4.body.es: Tan bonito era Oliver que los niños jugaron con él. A la hora de dormir, Oliver los siguió hasta su casa.

scene.5.body.en: It was bedtime, and his afternoon of fun — his one break from life on the street — had come to an end.
scene.5.body.es: Ya que era hora de dormir, su momento de diversión y distracción de su vida callejera había llegado a su fin.

scene.6.body.en: With no family and no home of his own, Oliver cried every night.
scene.6.body.es: Como Oliver seguía sin familia y sin un hogar propio, lloraba todas las noches.

scene.7.body.en: Unable to leave a puppy in such a state, we started bringing him food and water, and looking after him until he could find a family and a home of his own.
scene.7.body.es: Oliver recibe atención mientras encontramos un lugar para el.

scene.8.body.en: We've done what we can for him, but the truth is Oliver deserves more than we can give. We already have two dogs of our own, and a third isn't possible long-term. So he's still waiting for a home he can call his own.
scene.8.body.es: Hemos hecho lo posible para cuidarlo, sin embargo, Oliver merece más de lo que podemos ofrecer. Tenemos nuestros dos perros y no es posible tener un tercero a largo plazo. Así que Oliver sigue esperando encontrar un hogar que pueda llamar suyo para siempre.

trait.energetic.body.en: Oliver loves to run, and he makes a perfect running partner.
trait.energetic.body.es: A Oliver le encanta correr. Es el compañero perfecto para salir a trotar.

trait.affectionate.body.en: Oliver loves people, and wants nothing more than to be wherever you are.
trait.affectionate.body.es: Oliver ama a la gente, y no quiere nada más que estar donde tú estés.

trait.trainable.body.en: Oliver picked up sit, stay and come very quickly, and he's ready to keep learning with his forever family.
trait.trainable.body.es: Oliver conoce los comandos: "sentado", "quieto" y "ven". Él está listo para seguir aprendiendo.

trait.kids.body.en: Oliver loves playing with kids, and his ears perk up whenever he hears them.
trait.kids.body.es: A Oliver le encanta jugar con los niños. Puede pasar horas jugando con ellos.

trait.dogs.body.en: He shares a home with other dogs and gets on with all of them.  Though he can still be a little rambunctious.
trait.dogs.body.es: Vive con otros perros y se lleva bien con todos.

trait.calm.body.en: After a morning walk and a little training, Oliver settles right down indoors — he eats, and then he sleeps.
trait.calm.body.es: Después de un paseo por la mañana y un poco de entrenamiento, Oliver se calma en casa: come, y luego duerme.

note.body.en: He doesn't quite know how big he is yet, so he still needs teaching to be gentle around children and smaller dogs.
note.body.es: Todavía no se da cuenta de lo grande que es, así que hay que seguir enseñándole a ser delicado con los niños y con perros más pequeños.

step.where.value.en: If you would like to adopt him, we can fly with him to California, or of course you can visit him here in Aguascalientes.
step.where.value.es: Aguascalientes — ven a conocerlo y ver si es el perro perfecto para tú familia.

step.health.value.en: All his vaccinations are up to date. He has not been neutered yet.
step.health.value.es: Todas sus vacunas están al día. Todavía no está castrado.

step.cost.value.es: No hay ninguna cuota por Oliver.

step.ask.value.en: Only that he goes somewhere he can run and play, somewhere he won't be alone all day, and somewhere willing to keep up the training he's already started.
step.ask.value.es: Qué llegue a un lugar donde pueda correr y jugar, donde no se quede solo todo el día, y donde estén dispuestos a seguir con el entrenamiento que ya empezó.

closing.body.en: Send a message and we'll tell you anything you want to know about him — honestly, including the parts that aren't perfect.
closing.body.es: Escríbenos y te contamos lo que quieras saber de él — con honestidad, incluso lo que no es perfecto.

photo.hero.alt.en: Oliver, a young black dog with a white speckled chest, sitting and looking at the camera with his tongue out, wearing an orange bandana.
photo.hero.alt.es: Oliver, un perro joven de pelaje negro con el pecho moteado de blanco, sentado y mirando a la cámara con la lengua de fuera y una bandana naranja.

slide.1.alt.en: Oliver sitting and facing the camera, tongue out, wearing an orange bandana.
slide.1.alt.es: Oliver sentado de frente a la cámara, con la lengua de fuera y una bandana naranja.

slide.2.videoAria.en: Video: Oliver holding a sit-stay outdoors with his lead trailing loose on the ground, then coming when called and walking at heel.
slide.2.videoAria.es: Video: Oliver se queda sentado afuera con la correa arrastrando por el suelo, luego viene cuando lo llaman y camina pegado a la persona.

slide.3.cap.en: Mid-grin, which is where his face spends most of its time.
slide.3.cap.es: A media sonrisa, que es como pasa casi todo el día.

slide.3.alt.en: Oliver sitting side-on, grinning up and away from the camera, in a bright orange bandana.
slide.3.alt.es: Oliver sentado de lado, sonriendo hacia arriba, con una bandana naranja brillante.

slide.4.cap.en: Wouldn't you love to see this beautiful face greet you?
slide.4.cap.es: ¿No te encantaría que esta hermosa carita te recibiera todos los días?

slide.4.videoAria.en: Video: Oliver leaning his head into an outstretched hand for a scratch.
slide.4.videoAria.es: Video: Oliver recarga la cabeza en una mano extendida para que lo acaricien.

slide.5.cap.en: Oliver after going out for a walk.

slide.5.alt.en: Oliver lying down with his front paws stretched out in front of him, relaxed.
slide.5.alt.es: Oliver acostado con las patas delanteras estiradas al frente, relajado.

slide.6.cap.en: Self-control training.  He's a quick learner

slide.6.videoAria.en: Video: Oliver placing his paw into a waiting hand.
slide.6.videoAria.es: Video: Oliver pone la pata en una mano que lo espera.

slide.7.alt.en: Oliver lying on the floor in profile, with another dog standing just behind him.
slide.7.alt.es: Oliver acostado de perfil en el piso, con otro perro parado justo detrás.

hero.kicker.en: Aguascalientes, México  ·  looking for a home

hero.lede.en: A beautiful and energetic puppy, searching for his forever home.
hero.lede.es: Es un cachorro precioso y lleno de energía, que busca un hogar para siempre.

meta.description.en: Oliver is a young, energetic, very trainable street dog from Aguascalientes, Mexico, looking for a home. Photos, video, and how to meet him.

meta.og.description.en: He followed some kids home from the park one afternoon and never left. Now he's looking for a family of his own.
meta.og.description.es: He followed some kids home from the park one afternoon and never left. Now he's looking for a family of his own.
